# DevLeveler

> AI-Powered Developer Intelligence Platform

DevLeveler is a web platform for software engineers, students, and job seekers that evaluates technical proof-of-work across public code repositories, resume keyword alignment, and project architecture to calculate an objective Developer Score and recommend personalized learning milestones.

## Verified Capabilities
- Developer Score: Calculates a 0-100 composite score based on projects and code quality, GitHub activity volume, skill balance, ATS resume compliance, and deployment preparation.
- GitHub Telemetry Analysis: Audits repository structure, commit patterns, language distributions, and repository hygiene.
- ATS Resume Optimizer: Parses resume keywords and technical terminology to check compliance against software engineering hiring standards.
- Personalized Career Roadmap: Generates weekly milestones and targeted skill targets calibrated for frontend, backend, fullstack, and devops engineering roles.
- Public Verification Profiles: Provides shareable public developer portfolios with verified achievements and score breakdowns.

## Public Canonical URLs
- Homepage: https://devleveler.vercel.app/
- Sign In: https://devleveler.vercel.app/login
- Sign Up: https://devleveler.vercel.app/signup
